title: A deep field of galaxies
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: Light from more distant galaxies generally takes longer to reach us. We see those galaxies at earlier stages, rather than seeing their present appearance directly.

misconception: A learner may choose: Distant galaxies are always intrinsically younger today
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: For distant galaxies, why does looking farther away usually mean looking further back in cosmic history?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: For distant galaxies, why does looking farther away usually mean looking further back in cosmic history? Their light generally spent longer traveling to us. Light from more distant galaxies generally takes longer to reach us. We see those galaxies at earlier stages, rather than seeing their present appearance directly.
